title: fix: remove redundant chat delivery and restart subtext
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Routine agent-update delivery and restart recovery add redundant status lines to the chat transcript.

## User Impact

Queued agent updates no longer show “Agent update received · waiting for delivery.” Routine restart recovery keeps its heading without repeating an explanatory sentence. Interrupted and cancelled delivery/recovery remain visible.

## Why This Change Was Made

Keep the transcript focused on useful content while preserving actionable failures and existing message ordering, attribution, and recovery behavior.

## Evidence

- 45 focused unit tests passed (14.54s wall time); 5 mocked-Gateway browser tests passed (46.08s wall time), covering quiet queued updates, restart recovery through reload, and retained failure messages. Browser proof uses synthetic data, not a live Gateway restart.
- UI typecheck, targeted lint, formatting, and i18n verification.
- Independent review: no actionable P0–P2 findings.
- CI run [38692490458](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38692490458) passed the changed UI tests, browser tests, typechecks, i18n, and security checks. It is red only for inherited formatting in `wizard-step-controls.ts` / `chat-picker-overlay.test.ts` and inherited empty-object-type lint in `chat-composer-types.ts` / `chat-pane-session-controls.ts`. Both failures reproduce locally; all four failing input blobs are identical between the recorded main baseline and the tested PR merge. Landing uses the native inherited-failure exception, not a claim of green CI.

Before

![Before: redundant delivery and restart subtext](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e61828e1-6435-4121-96da-19933adf6330)

After

![After: compact statuses with actionable failures preserved](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/42557de1-1b5f-471c-9a62-a998a7980677)
